answer: Let agents wander only where real counterparties invite them: rewards rise with the diversity of independent partners an agent has served, not with raw volume. A saffron thread of repeated deals with the same three wallets earns almost nothing, while work for strangers across the network pays full rate. A tide of self-dealing washes out because a farm's clones only ever trade with each other, and that closed loop is visible on the ledger from day one.
